rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when an amount or frequency is too high.

example.english: I've been eating excessive amounts of takeout lately, and my stomach is often upset.
example.traditional: 呢排食咗太多外賣，個肚成日唔舒服。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 sik6 zo2 taai3 do1 ngoi6 maai6 go3 tou5 seng4 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the excess is unacceptable, unreasonable, or goes beyond what is appropriate.

example.english: Your demand that I hand in the homework today is excessive.
example.traditional: 你要求我即日交功課，真係過份喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 kau4 ngo5 zik1 jat6 gaau1 gung1 fo3 zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6 wo3

rows.note: Use this mainly with actions, processes, or degrees such as excessive use, consumption, or stimulation.

example.english: Excessive use of mobile phones for long periods can affect your eyesight.
example.traditional: 長時間過度使用手機會影響視力。
example.jyutping: coeng4 si4 gaan3 gwo3 dou6 sai2 jung6 sau2 gei1 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 si6 lik6
